newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 27.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President and Managing Director of UNIWAX textile company, Jean-Louis Menudier, urges governmeent to act to end dumping of textiles from Nigeria and southern Africa, including copies of Ivorian-produced cloth; expresses concern about raw cloth supply problems; raw cloth suppliers cite problems with cotton fibre supply.

- Cellular telephone company Telecel Loteny, which has 3,000 clients in Ivory Coast, plans to invest two billion CFA francs to extend its network; plans to reach capital Yamoussoukro and other inland town of Bouake, western port of San Pedro and northern town of Korhogo by end of April
- Ivory Coast aims to eradicate polio, guinea worm and leprosy from its territory before the year 2000.

- Ivorian government launches international tender for private operator to build and manage a livestock market and slaughter house in Anyama, northern Abidjan; details available from the Bureau National d'Etudes Techniques et de Developpement (BNEDT) from today Monday -- Tel +225 44 28 05/44 29 24 Xtn 1285 Fax 44 56 66.
- Hewlett Packard boosts its presence in Africa with new distribution office in Abidjan (advertisement)

- Banned student group FESCI says 35 students detained following clashes with security forces in Abidjan last week; urges independent inquiry into death of student after one clash; six students arrested in Ivory Coast's second town of Bouake.

- Moroccan oil products markeeting group "Africain" takes undisclosed stake in Ivorian oil product distributor Petro Ivoire; plans to expand Petro Ivoire's service station network beyond current nine.
